propositions: Project overlay routing cannot today extend built-in code-review overlay triggers; only standalone project.* criteria are supported.
The registry must support additive trigger_tokens (literal substring matching) and applies_to globs per built-in overlay id, unioned with committed triggers at consumption time.
A helper function project_trigger_extensions() must read project overlay raw entries directly and return per-overlay-id trigger extensions, threaded from overlay_union call site.
glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must union project-extension values with committed ones, preserving existing behavior when no project overlay is present.
Malformed project entries (non-list trigger_tokens, non-string tokens, unknown ids) must be ignored without raising errors.
